worked_solution: Taxable income = ₹9,00,000 − ₹75,000 = ₹8,25,000. Slab tax: ₹4,00,000 × 5% = ₹20,000; ₹25,000 × 10% = ₹2,500 → ₹22,500. Taxable income is within ₹12,00,000, so the rebate (up to ₹60,000) cancels the tax: ₹22,500 − ₹22,500 = ₹0. Cess on nil tax is ₹0. Total = ₹0.
